verses.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: chatur baran mil sura(n)g ta(n)bol ras gursikh saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g mai ra(n)geele hai ||

en.bdb: As the union of beetle leaf, beetle nut, lime and catechu produce deep red colour, so do the Sikhs living in the presence of Satguru get dyed in hue of his love and Naam in the company of True and noble Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਂਡ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੂਨ ਜਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੈ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: khaa(n)dd ghirat choon jal mile bi(n)janaadh savaiaadh prem ras a(n)mirat mai rasik raseele hai ||

en.bdb: As the mixing of sugar, clarified butter, flour and water results in various types of dainty dishes, similarly Guru-conscious persons become the relishers of elixir like Naam in the company of the holy and noble people who themselves are engrossed in the meditation of Lord's name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਸੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sakal suga(n)dh sanaba(n)dh aragajaa hoi sabadh surat liv baasanaa baseele hai ||

en.bdb: As all fragrances when put together result in a perfume of high quality, similarly the servant Sikhs of the Guru become pleasant smelling by virtue of Naam Simran and instilling the words of Guru in their conscious mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥੯੪॥
verses.translit_en: paaras paras jaise kanik anik dhaat dhib dheh man unaman unameele hai ||94||

en.bdb: As many metals turn into gold by the touch of paaras (Philosopher-Stone), so do the devoted Sikhs become refulgent and blossoms in the company of True Guru. (94)
